'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[2021 Niger attacks]]
***Sixteen [[Niger Armed Forces|Nigerien soldiers]] are killed and six others wounded when their patrol is [[ambush]]ed in [[Tahoua Region|Tahoua]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/3/16-soldiers-killed-in-western-niger-ambush (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Kodyel attack]]
***At least 30 civilians are killed and 20 more wounded as several armed men assault a village in [[Foutouri (department)|Foutouri]], [[Burkina Faso]]. It is one of the deadliest attacks in the country's history. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/4/dozens-killed-in-eastern-burkina-faso-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***A bomb explodes near a school in [[Farah, Afghanistan|Farah]], injuring 21 people, including ten students. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/bomb-explodes-school-western-afghanistan/story?id=77471493 (ABC News)]
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes|2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**[[Kyrgyzstan]] and [[Tajikistan]] complete the withdrawal of their forces from the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|border]]. [https://www.timesca.com/index.php/news/23736-kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-withdraw-military-units-from-border-after-deadly-clashes (''The Times of Central Asia'')]
**Tajikistan says the border clashes left several people dead on their side. The death toll for Kyrgyzstan reaches 36 following the death of a four-year-old boy. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/3/in-first-admission-tajikistan-concedes-deaths-in-recent-clashes (Al Jazeera)] [https://akipress.com/news:657731:Kyrgyzstan_s_death_toll_in_Kyrgyz-Tajik_border_conflict_rises_to_36/ (AKIPress)]
**[[President of Tajikistan|Tajik President]] [[Emomali Rahmon]] orders that all residential buildings destroyed in [[Chorku, Tajikistan|Chorkuh]] be restored. [https://asiaplustj.info/en/news/tajikistan/power/20210503/tajik-leader-orders-to-restore-destroyed-residential-buildings-in-chorkuh-at-the-expense-of-the-state (Asia-Plus)]
**[[Kyrgyz people|Kyrgyzs]] in [[Germany]] and the [[United Kingdom]] organize rallies and protests at [[List of diplomatic missions of Tajikistan|Tajik embassies]]. Additionally, citizens living in [[San Francisco]] protest in support of the residents of [[Batken]] and call for international institutions to "bring Tajik President Rahmon to justice". [http://en.kabar.kg/news/kyrgyz-citizens-abroad-organize-rallies-in-front-of-tajik-embassies/ (Kabar)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**The [[Kachin Independence Army]] says that it shot down a [[military helicopter]] of the [[Tatmadaw|armed forces]]. The [[separatist]] group's information department head reported that they were attacked with [[airstrike]]s and that they shot back. In a separate incident, a junta-appointed local administrator is stabbed to death in [[Yangon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-rebel-group-says-shoots-down-military-helicopter-2021-05-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the arts and cultural heritage]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
**[[Bavaria]]n [[List of ministers-president of Bavaria|minister-president]] [[Markus Söder]] announces that the annual [[Oktoberfest]] celebrations in [[Munich]], scheduled for late September to October, will be cancelled for a second consecutive year due to the pandemic. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/05/04/21/germany-oktoberfest-cancelled-again-over-coronavirus (ABS-CBN News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mexico City Metro overpass collapse]]
**A [[viaduct]] collapses in the [[Tezonco metro station|Tezonco]]–[[Olivos metro station|Olivos]] [[Elevated railway|elevated]] interstation of [[Mexico City Metro Line 12|Line 12]] of the [[Mexico City Metro]]. At least 23 people are killed and at least 70 others injured a train subsequently fell onto the road below. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56977129 (BBC News)]
*At least 26 people are killed when a speedboat collides with a vessel transporting sand on the [[Padma River]] in [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/3/at-least-26-killed-in-bangladesh-boat-accident (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Telangana]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on animals]]
*****Eight [[Asiatic lion]]s in [[Nehru Zoological Park|Hyderabad Zoo]] test positive for [[COVID-19]], the first such case in India. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/8-lions-in-city-zoo-test-ve-for-covid-1st-such-case-in-india/articleshow/82377122.cms (Times of India)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Haryana]], [[COVID-19 lockdown in India]]
*****[[Haryana]] imposes a seven-day complete lockdown due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases across the state. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Delhi/haryana-government-announces-7-day-lockdown-starting-today/article34467998.ece (''The Hindu'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi]]
*****Authorities in [[Delhi]] request help from the [[Indian Armed Forces]] amidst shortages of medical oxygen and a lack of beds in [[intensive care unit]]s in the city's overwhelmed hospitals. The local government wants the [[Indian Army|army]] to formally take over the administration of COVID-19 care facilities and intensive care units. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-56972286 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports its first two cases of the [[Lineage B.1.617]] variant, first discovered in [[India]], in two people from [[Jakarta]]. The country also reports its first case of the [[Lineage B.1.351]] variant, first discovered in [[South Africa]], in a person from [[Bali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-says-finds-two-cases-indian-covid-19-variant-jakarta-2021-05-03/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
*****[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] receives his first dose of the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/05/04/philippines-duterte-receives-first-dose-of-sinopharms-covid-vaccine.html (CNBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record 31 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 276. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2109635/record-31-covid-deaths-2-041-new-infections (''Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Algeria]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Algeria]] reports its first six cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant, first discovered in India, in people from the coastal [[Provinces of Algeria|province]] of [[Tipaza]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/05/03/Algeria-finds-first-cases-of-Indian-COVID-19-variant (Al-Arabiya English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]], Lineage B.1.617
****[[Morocco]] reports its first cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant, which was first discovered in India, in two people from [[Casablanca]]. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2021/05/341299/morocco-records-2-cases-of-covid-19-indian-variant-in-casablanca/ (Morocco World News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tanzania]], [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
****The [[Government of Tanzania]] announces that all travellers will be required to present negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test]] results at border points in order to reduce the spread of new variants. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tanzania-once-sceptical-covid-19-announces-measures-curb-new-variants-2021-05-03/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Denmark]] becomes the first country to exclude the [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine]] from its [[COVID-19 vaccination|vaccination programme]] over a potential link to a rare but serious form of [[thrombosis]]. [https://cphpost.dk/?p=124280 (''The Copenhagen Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****Cafés, restaurants, and bars in [[Greece]] reopen for the first time in six months as the [[Government of Greece|government]] begins to ease its COVID-19 restrictions. A nightly 9:00 p.m. curfew is also changed to 11:00 p.m. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-greece-coronavirus-restaurants-lifestyle-47a2f256fa97466ba4a0c5057ab72435 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut]]
****[[Governor of Connecticut|Governor]] [[Ned Lamont]] announces that [[Connecticut]] has fully [[Vaccination|vaccinated]] 50% of its adult population, thereby making it the first state to do so. [https://www.ctpost.com/news/article/CT-first-in-nation-to-fully-vaccinate-50-of-16148489.php (''Connecticut Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
****[[Governor of Florida|Florida Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] announces that, on July 1, the [[Florida|state]] will suspend all local COVID-19 emergency measures. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/desantis-florida-covid-local-emergency-mandates/ (CBS News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Iran]] denies yesterday's reports of an agreement to [[exchange prisoners]] with the [[United States]] and the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.presstv.com/Detail/2021/05/03/651822/Iran-denies-prisoner-swap-deal-with-US (PressTV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes|2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**The prosecutor general's office of [[Tajikistan]] launches a criminal investigation into servicemen and citizens of [[Kyrgyzstan]] for "unleashing an aggressive war". [https://en.trend.az/casia/kyrgyzstan/3418455.html (Trend News Agency)]
**The [[Prosecutor General's Office of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz Prosecutor General's Office]] accuses the [[Armed Forces of the Republic of Tajikistan|Tajikistan Armed Forces]] of invading the country and seizing their sovereign territory. [https://kaktus.media/doc/437622_genprokyratyra:_voennye_rt_vtorglis_v_kyrgyzstan_s_celu_zahvata_territorii.html (Katkus Media)]
*[[Law enforcement in Germany|German police]] say that they have dismantled one of the world's largest [[child pornography]] networks on the [[dark web]], with over 400,000 registered users. Four people have been detained in [[police raid|raids]], including a man from [[Paraguay]], on suspicion of running the network. [[Europol]] also says that several [[paedophile]] chat sites were taken down in the German-led [[intelligence agency|intelligence]] operation. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-56969414 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Colombian protests]]
**[[President of Colombia|Colombian President]] [[Iván Duque Márquez]] says that he is withdrawing a controversial [[tax reform]] proposal after thousands of predominantly [[Working class|working-class]] people took to the streets to protest against the plans, which they say unfairly target the poor. Seventeen people were killed in the protests. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56970028 (BBC News)]
*[[Asylum in the United States]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] raises the cap on the number of [[refugee]]s accepted each year, from 15,000 to 62,500. The move follows criticism from members of [[Democratic Party (United States)|his party]] and refugee agencies over his prior proposal to retain the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump]]-era cap. Biden also announces that he plans to further raise the cap to 125,000 next year. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-56975402 (BBC News)] 

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 Indian Premier League]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cricket]]
**A match between [[Kolkata Knight Riders]] and [[Royal Challengers Bangalore]] is postponed amidst a breach of the [[Indian Premier League|IPL]]'s biosecure bubble as [[Varun Chakravarthy]] and [[Sandeep Warrier]], as well as a senior coach, all tested positive for COVID-19. [https://amp.theguardian.com/sport/2021/may/03/cricket-indian-premier-league-match-postponed-after-knight-riders-players-test-covid-positive (''The Guardian'')]
